task: Draft a formal inquiry of about 70–110 words to a fictional venue before a group books a workshop. Ask about the relevant access arrangements without assuming that the venue has been inspected, promising suitability for everyone, or requesting participants' diagnoses. Make clear which materials the group itself can supply.

facts.text: The group is considering the Pavilion meeting room for a workshop next month.
The group needs to ask whether a hearing loop is installed and working.
The group needs to ask whether the meeting room can be reached without steps.
The group can bring large-print agendas.
The venue has not yet supplied access information.

forbidden_additions: A confirmed booking or a claim that the venue is accessible or legally compliant.
A requirement for participants to disclose medical information.
A promise that the venue will provide the large-print agendas.
preserve: Questions distinguished from established venue features.
A respectful practical inquiry before commitment.
The group's offer to supply its own large-print material.
